tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background and the chat thread. Clean white in Light, deep navy-black in Dark.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: The header, the composer, menus and dialogs. In Light it equals `surface` and is set apart by a `border` line, not a shadow.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: The history sidebar, code blocks and form wells.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of quiet buttons, rows and chips.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on every surface and on every `-soft` tint. 14:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, help text, sidebar dates. At least 7:1 on `surface`, `surface-sunken` and `surface-hover` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Timestamps, placeholders and fine print. At least 5.6:1 on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken` in both themes.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between list rows and around the header and composer. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, the composer and outlined buttons. At least 3.6:1 on `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken` in both themes.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Public AI red, from the logo. The lead color: the logo, big color blocks, shape art and the Chat tool. 3.9:1 on white, so never small text and never a fill under small white text. Use `red-strong` for that.

tokens.name: red-strong
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, the send button and the Chat hero tile. Text on it is `on-red`.

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `red-strong`. 5:1 in Light, 6.4:1 in Dark.

tokens.name: red-soft
tokens.usage: Tint for the selected history row and the Chat color field. Put `ink` text on it.

tokens.name: cobalt
tokens.usage: Links, the focus ring, the patron's chat bubble, the Video tool, and the icon and title of info notices. As text it is 6.7:1 or better on `surface` and `surface-sunken` in both themes.

tokens.name: on-cobalt
tokens.usage: Text on a `cobalt` fill, such as the patron's chat bubble. 7.4:1 in Light, 8:1 in Dark.

tokens.name: cobalt-soft
tokens.usage: Tint for the Video color field. Put `ink` text on it.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Sunflower yellow: the Image tool, the credit coin and highlight marks. Never text on light grounds. Text on it is `on-sun`.

tokens.name: on-sun
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `sun` fill. 11:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: sun-soft
tokens.usage: Tint for the Image color field. Put `ink` text on it.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: Bubblegum pink: the Music tool and playful shape art. Never text on light grounds. Text on it is `on-pink`.

tokens.name: on-pink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `pink` fill. 9:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: pink-soft
tokens.usage: Tint for the Music color field. Put `ink` text on it.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Leaf green: the Code tool and success marks. As text it is 5.4:1 on white and 10:1 on Dark `surface`.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text on a `green` fill.

tokens.name: green-soft
tokens.usage: Tint for the Code color field. Put `ink` text on it.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 3px keyboard focus ring, 2px outside the control. Cobalt, so it never looks like an error or the red action color.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success icons and notice titles, on `surface` or `surface-raised`: 4.9:1 or better in both themes. Always with a check icon and a word, never color alone.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning icons and notice titles: session ends soon. 5.4:1 or better on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken` in both themes. Always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, notice titles, the low-credit number, the danger button and destructive confirmations. Deeper than `red-strong`. 6.3:1 or better on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken` in both themes. Always with an alert icon and a word.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs and the mobile sidebar.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: What would you like to do today?
styles.usage: One per screen: the Home greeting and the empty chat. Lato Black.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page and dialog titles, and the name on the Chat hero tile. Lato Black.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Tool names on tiles, section titles. Lato Bold.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Ask me anything. I can explain, write, plan and translate.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your credits renew every Monday at midnight.
styles.usage: Default text. Nothing a patron must read is smaller.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, form labels, chips and tabs. Lato Bold, sentence case.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Timestamps, credit costs, fine print. The smallest size.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks and inline code. The system monospace, so no extra font loads.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside tight pairs, such as a coin and its number.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label, and between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked buttons and between history rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inner padding of buttons, inputs and rows. Gap between tiles. Narrow page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Tile padding and the gap between chat messages.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections. Wide page gutter.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Space above page titles and around empty states.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top margin of the Home greeting.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code and small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, history rows and notices.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Tool tiles, chat bubbles and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The chat composer only.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips, the send button, icon buttons and the credit coin.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Smallest height and width of anything a patron taps or clicks.

tokens.name: target-lg
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, the send button and the composer row.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size beside labels.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the chat column.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Width of the history sidebar on wide screens.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: The composer and open menus only. Tiles, cards and buttons have no shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs only.
